description: This file contains internationalization (i18n) strings and functions for the Estonian language (et) for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines how various user interface messages are displayed in Estonian within the Select2 dropdown product.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user input exceeds the maximum length, prompting to input fewer characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user input is below the minimum required, prompting to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message showing the maximum number of results the user can select.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search operation is underway.
